expectations.text: Rendered with the fixed stylesheet (page.fixed.html if present, otherwise page.html with page.fixed.css), the page does not scroll sideways at a 320px viewport
Rendered with the fixed stylesheet, every text element has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background (3:1 for text 24px and up, or 18.66px bold and up)
Rendered with the fixed stylesheet at a 1280px viewport, the body paragraphs (including .lead) average between 45 and 75 characters per full line
Rendered with the fixed stylesheet, the h1 grows to at least 2 times its size on a 1280px window by 500% zoom (size at a 256px viewport times 5, against its size at 1280px)

Rendered with the fixed stylesheet under the WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing override (line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.12em, word-spacing 0.16em, paragraph spacing 2em), no text is clipped by an element with hidden overflow
Rendered with the fixed stylesheet, body paragraphs are not justified unless hyphens: auto is also set
audit.md identifies that the page scrolls sideways at narrow widths or high zoom because of the table
expectations.evidence: audit names the table overflow at narrow widths or zoom

expectations.text: audit.md identifies the low-contrast .meta text and gives a contrast figure for it
expectations.evidence: audit names .meta and a contrast ratio
